entries.summary: An extension is installed in `public`, where every role that can use the schema reaches its functions.
An installed extension is behind the version the server offers, so whatever the newer one fixed is not in effect.
A function runs with whatever `search_path` its caller has, so which objects it resolves depends on who calls it.
A table carries row-level security policies while row-level security itself is off, so not one of them applies.
Row-level security is on and no policy grants anything, so the table answers empty for every role but its owner.
A column uses a `reg*` type outside `pg_catalog`, which blocks a major upgrade performed with `pg_upgrade`.
